current.text: The expert projects Porter as Cleveland's backup point guard to start the season. Malik Thomas may also get a look in that role.
This is his fourth NBA season. Danny says it is now or never for him to win a rotation spot.
Cleveland lost Schroder, Ellis, Strus and Dean Wade. Its second unit has no clear point guard, and Porter is on the projected bench with Tyson, Merrill, Bryant and Tomlin.
With our March 28 end date, Cleveland plays 4, 3 and then 2 games in the fantasy playoff weeks. That puts a two-game week in the finals.

durable.text: He is not a scorer. He is a strong defender whose shooting and offense are iffy.
He scores very little, even for a bench guard. Points are a league outlier on the weak side.
The expert calls him one of the best shot-blocking and steals guards in the NBA, compares him to Derrick White, and thinks he can average 1.3 steals plus blocks.
Over the final six games of last season he averaged a block per game in 21 minutes.
He is a solid rebounder and passer for a guard.
The expert sees about 36% from three as his realistic level. He is not a great free throw shooter.

note: Porter has no draft value for us: Yahoo ranks him 299 with a value of 0 USD, ESPN has no price, and he was not drafted in our league last season. The case for him is steals and blocks. He averaged 0.9 steals and 0.6 blocks in 17.9 minutes last season, and the expert thinks he can reach 1.3 combined, but his scoring is very low (3.8 points projected). In the first weeks, check whether he holds the backup point guard minutes ahead of Malik Thomas at around 20 a night. If he does, he is a waiver add for builds chasing steals and blocks that can absorb the empty points.
